annotations.title: Check a tokenized stock before you buy

description: Check a tokenized stock BEFORE BUYING it, by its contract (or Solana mint) and network: can it be moved today (pause state, a permanent delegate), is a controlling address on the OFAC SDN list, does the pool price track the issuer’s reference, is there DEX liquidity to sell into, is it concentrated in one holder, and is it backed where the issuer reports reserves. Each question has a state (ok, caution, not_established) and the answer an overall status: caution, no_warning_found or not_established. Never "safe", never advice. Free.

address.description: The token contract (0x…) or Solana mint.

chain.description: The network, where one address is a token on several (ethereum, arbitrum, base, bnb, robinhood, solana, …).

sizeUsd.description: The position the sell question is asked for, in dollars; $10,000 where none is sent.

name: stock_buy_check
